questions.question: A company wants to strengthen its network defences before deploying monitoring tools. State SIX (6) preventive network security mechanisms and, for each, briefly describe what it does.

marking_points.point: Firewall: filters inbound and outbound network traffic according to predefined security rules.
marking_points.quote: Control incoming and outgoing traffic on network with predetermined security policies.

marking_points.point: Proxy server: improves data security and network performance, acting as a firewall and web filter while caching data.
marking_points.quote: Proxy servers act as a firewall and web filter, provide shared network connections, and cache data to speed up common requests.

marking_points.point: Network segmentation: creates boundaries between network segments whose assets share a common function, risk or role.
marking_points.quote: Boundaries between network segments where computing assets within the segment have a common function, risk or role within an organization.

marking_points.point: Remote access VPN: gives individual hosts or clients secure remote access to the organization network.
marking_points.quote: Provides remote and secure access to an organization network to individual hosts or clients

marking_points.point: Zero Trust Network Access: restricts each user to only the access and permissions needed for their role.
marking_points.quote: A user should only has access and permission that required to fulfill the role

marking_points.point: IDS/IPS: detects or prevents attacks such as brute force, Denial-of-Service and exploitation of network vulnerabilities.
marking_points.quote: To detect or prevent the network security attacks such as brute force attacks, Denial-of-Service attacks and exploits of network vulnerabilities.
